description:
Searches vertodigital.com and returns matching page links with one-line summaries as markdown, never page content (read a page with vertodigital_get_page).
Scopes: "pages" (default) is every page, blog posts, ebooks, events and case studies included; "case_studies" is client results with headline stats; "offer" is the services, proof points and differentiators that fit a buyer's challenge.
Matching: each query word must start a word in an entry ("attribut" finds "attribution"); "offer" also takes a full sentence. No query lists the whole scope.
Results: all matches in one response, no pagination (the full index is under 30 KB). No match returns match_count 0 and a hint, not an error.

query.description: Keywords such as "LinkedIn Ads" or "HubSpot"; for scope "offer", a challenge in plain words.

section.description: Heading filter for scopes "pages" and "case_studies": case-insensitive substring, e.g. "Services", "Cybersecurity". An unknown heading is ignored, with a note.

name: vertodigital_search_site
